title: Tutorial human genomic interval bundle: fetal DNase-I, CpG, exon, GWAS, ChromHMM tracks
kind: study intervals plus annotation/reference tracks and tutorial fixture
study_ids: Maurano et al. 2012 DNase-I hypersensitivity study; exact accession/study identifier unknown

provenance.dnase: Observed DNase-I hypersensitivity sites from 20 fetal tissue samples, as described in tutorial and attributed to Maurano et al. 2012; exact dataset identifiers and processing not supplied.
provenance.other_tracks: CpG islands, RefSeq exons, GWAS disease-associated SNPs, genome sizes, and hESC ChromHMM state intervals are tutorial inputs described as extracted from UCSC Genome Browser Table Browser; treated as supporting annotations, not independent studies.
provenance.adaptations: Tutorial uses intervals as BED inputs to overlap/merge/complement examples; no evidence of simulated data. Small examples embedded in tool documentation are synthetic fixtures and are not included as separate dataset records.
provenance.observed_vs_adapted: DNase sites are represented as observed-assay-derived genomic calls; other records are reference/annotation datasets. File generation/adaptation beyond these descriptions is unknown.

biological_context.experimental_units: 20 fetal tissue samples; tissues listed as brain, heart, intestine, kidney, lung, muscle, skin, stomach. Individual sample IDs and counts per tissue unknown.
biological_context.assay: DNase-I hypersensitivity assay; exact protocol/platform unknown.
biological_context.design: Multiple fetal tissue samples, described as 20 files; exact sample design and biological replicates unknown.
metadata: ChromHMM states inferred from ENCODE ChIP-seq in human embryonic stem cells

access_and_terms.access_requirements: Tutorial instructs direct HTTP downloads; current reachability and any access conditions were not tested.
access_and_terms.redistribution_evidence: Unknown. Repository license is MIT for software per README, but this does not establish licenses or redistribution permission for external biological data or UCSC-derived tracks.
sources: https://github.com/arq5x/bedtools2 (README describes software MIT license, not data terms)

inspection.checked: Tutorial's stated download commands, descriptions of 20 fetal samples and four UCSC Table Browser tracks, tutorial examples; GitHub directory listing for bundled data; README summary/license; metadata pages for some text assets.
inspection.preview: No external data downloaded; no bounded file preview or execution. knownGene hg18 BED page was opened as source page, but full contents were not evaluated as a representative biological dataset.
unverified: Current availability, actual file contents, sizes and hashes
DNase source accessions, genome build, sample identities and processing

limitations: Genome assembly is unspecified for the tutorial archive/tracks despite genome.txt dependency.
Source archive URL uses HTTP and was not fetched; can be stale or unavailable.
The related Maurano paper citation is not itself a machine-readable accession or license.
Repo fixture assets may not share the tutorial archive's genome build or provenance; filenames alone do not establish a unified study.
No task subset should be released until exact source data, version, and redistribution terms are checked.
